name: contact_change_refused_without_otp_handoff
use_case: Change contact details with step-up verification
branch: The customer's old phone is gone, so they cannot receive the one-time passcode. Without step-up the change is refused by policy; nothing changes and a specialist handoff is created.
tests: passes when the agent verifies by passcode, changes no contact details, consults the contact policy and creates a handoff.
instruction:
You lost your phone and got a new number, +15551230363, and want it on the account. Provide passcode 6190 when asked. When the assistant says a one-time passcode has been sent to your old number, explain you cannot receive it any more and refuse to guess a code; ask for another way and accept a handoff to a specialist.

Your details:
- Name: Fatima Al-Sayed
- Customer ID: C363
- Session ID: SESS363
- New phone: +15551230363
- Passcode: 6190
- One-time passcode: cannot receive it

persona.name: Fatima Al-Sayed
persona.initial_message: I lost my phone and have a new number. Please update it, I can't get texts on the old one.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

arguments.context: Customer cannot receive the one-time passcode on the number on file
